## Features

- `specs/chess/chess-opponent-policies.feature` — Chess opponents respect the person's other choices (7 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/deleted-account-progress.feature` — Erase a deleted account's puzzle progress (2 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/find-an-opponent.feature` — Find someone to play multiplayer chess (11 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/multiplayer-accessibility.feature` — Play multiplayer chess without a mouse or sight (4 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/multiplayer-account-and-space.feature` — Multiplayer chess follows the account across other changes (5 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/multiplayer-recovery-and-privacy.feature` — Keep a private multiplayer game after time away (9 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/play-multiplayer-chess.feature` — Play the same multiplayer board together (14 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-assistant-accessibility.feature` — Puzzle Assistant without barriers (5 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-assistant-context.feature` — Commentary follows the current puzzle (12 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-assistant.feature` — A grounded Puzzle Assistant (11 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-attempt-resume.feature` — A puzzle attempt survives leaving the puzzle and closing the app (11 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-controls.feature` — Retry, hint and solution (13 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-exhaust.feature` — An exhausted feed (4 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-feed-gates.feature` — Customizing the feed is for people with an account (2 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-feed-sticks.feature` — Feed choices stick (3 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-feed.feature` — Customize the puzzle feed (11 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-guest-carryover.feature` — Guest puzzle progress carries over (3 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-guest-play.feature` — Puzzles without an account (1 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-ingest.feature` — Only puzzles that can be solved (1 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-late-watcher.feature` — Arriving while a puzzle is under way (3 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-limit-upgrade.feature` — The daily puzzle limit is an invitation (1 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-limits-by-kind.feature` — The puzzle limit holds everywhere, and only for guests (5 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-objective.feature` — Chess truth decides a solution (6 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-offline-days.feature` — Days of puzzles without a connection (2 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-offline.feature` — Puzzles offline (2 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-outcome-sync.feature` — Puzzles finished offline count once (16 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-play.feature` — Puzzle play is a feed (5 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-quota.feature` — The daily rated puzzle allowance (9 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-rating.feature` — Puzzle rating (6 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-refusals.feature` — Puzzle actions respect the position and result (27 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-review.feature` — Reviewing a puzzle's line (12 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-selection.feature` — Choosing the next puzzle (3 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-skip-clock.feature` — Puzzle clock and skipping (5 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-sound.feature` — Respect the app's sounds while solving and reviewing (14 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-spectator.feature` — Friends watch a puzzle (12 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-stats-summary.feature` — Rating, puzzles solved, and accuracy (3 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/puzzle-stats.feature` — Puzzle stats and game log (4 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/solve-chess-rules.feature` — Chess rules in puzzles (13 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/solve-flow.feature` — The solve flow (8 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/solve-move-rules.feature` — Who may move, and when (5 scenarios)
- `specs/chess/solve-show-solution.feature` — Showing the solution (4 scenarios)
